info.title: Test CRM API
info.description:
Test CRM REST API. Authenticate with a workspace API key: send it as `Authorization: Bearer <key>` (or in an `X-Api-Key` header). Generate keys in the dashboard under Developers / API.

**Answers.** Success is `{ "data": ..., "meta": ... }`; a failure is `{ "error": { "code", "message", "details"? } }` with a stable snake_case `code`. Validation failures are always HTTP 422 with `details` listing the messages per field.

**Lists** are paged with a cursor: pass `limit` (1 to 100, default 25; `per_page` is accepted as an alias) and the `cursor` from `meta.next_cursor` of the previous page. Page numbers are not supported. Identifiers are UUIDs.

**Rate limit.** Each key is held to a number of requests per minute set by the workspace plan (the platform default applies when the plan sets none). Every answer carries `X-RateLimit-Limit` and `X-RateLimit-Remaining`; over the limit the answer is HTTP 429 with `Retry-After`.

tags.name: Template
tags.description: List, create, change and delete message templates, and send one to a single number.

tags.name: Media
tags.description: Upload a file once and reuse it in messages and templates.

tags.name: Contact
tags.description: The workspace address book: list, read, create, change and delete contacts, with free-form attributes.

tags.name: ContactGroup
tags.description: Named lists that contacts belong to: list, create and delete groups.

tags.name: Broadcast
tags.description: One-off bulk sends of a template: create, list, read, see per-recipient status and stop.

tags.name: Campaign
tags.description: Managed campaigns: create and dispatch, list, read live counts, read statistics, stop and delete.

tags.name: Scheduled
tags.description: Queue a message for a future time and manage the queue.

tags.name: Flow
tags.description: Read automation flows and enroll a contact into one by id or phone number.

tags.name: Device
tags.description: The connected sending numbers and their status.

tags.name: Webhook
tags.description: Register endpoints to receive Test CRM events (inbound messages, delivery status, contact and campaign changes) as signed JSON posts.

tags.name: Deal
